verdict.rationale: An agent can read and act on much of the tax posture through the REST API and official SDKs. Documented endpoints list nexuses for the org, create registrations, and get filings (filterable, or by registration ID). However, the MCP server only reads public docs and the OpenAPI spec and never proxies API calls. Credentials are an org-wide API key plus organization ID with expiry and rotation options, but no documented permission scoping. Missing for 10: an MCP surface that acts on account data, scoped/least-privilege credentials, an accrued liability endpoint, explicit upcoming-filing deadlines, and independent hands-on corroboration.
